title: EIGRP Summarization: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A big network has lots of small routes. You can squash them into one summary. That means fewer updates, and smaller tables.

scenes.heading: The library sorting system
scenes.narration: A library groups many books under one shelf label. A summary route covers many subnets at once. You set it on the interface, not under the router process. E I G R P adds a null zero route to stop loops. Filtering uses a distribute list, in or out.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Manual summaries work without auto summary. They behave differently. The summary points to null zero.

items.wrong: Summary points at the next hop

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva EIGRP summarization lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Summaries shrink tables and updates. They're set per interface. A null zero route stops loops. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva EIGRP summarization lab.
